logline: The fence: Gully, in the apron, at the shack, who has the missing page in a plastic sleeve on the high shelf and won't say where he got it. The dog puts a paw on the counter. Gully pours him a coffee in a saucer. That's the whole interrogation.

panels.composition: The shack. GULLY behind the counter. The dog in the trench coat with both paws on the counter's edge.

balloons.text: I don't know nothing about no page.

panels.composition: The high shelf behind Gully: a thermos, a tin, and a xeroxed page in a plastic sleeve.
panels.caption: It was on the shelf behind him. Fences always keep it behind them.

panels.composition: The dog drinking from the saucer. The page still on the shelf.
panels.caption: I took the coffee. The page could wait. The page always waits.
